amusement_park.name: Amusement Park
amusement_park.idea: Tourism: +commercial demand and land value within 12 tiles; draws visitors from neighbouring cities, but noisy (-residential desirability adjacent).

zoo.name: Zoo
zoo.idea: Attraction: +residential land value within 10 tiles and +tourism; needs road access and draws traffic on weekends.

botanical_garden.name: Botanical Garden
botanical_garden.idea: Education + calm: +residential land value within 8 tiles and a small pollution sink (-pollution in radius 4).

golf_course.name: Golf Course
golf_course.idea: Prestige: large +land value for residential within 10 tiles (attracts high-wealth), but costs big upkeep and lots of land.

marina.name: Marina
marina.idea: Waterfront tourism: +commercial demand and +land value for nearby waterfront tiles; must be placed on a coastline.

lighthouse.name: Lighthouse
lighthouse.idea: Coastal landmark: reduces shipwreck disasters and boosts seaport/marina trade within 20 tiles; small tourism bonus.

train_station.name: Train Station
train_station.idea: Transit hub: connects rail lines, -traffic on roads within 12 tiles and +commercial demand; passenger count scales with connected population.

bus_depot.name: Bus Depot
bus_depot.idea: Public transit: buses serve zones within 15 tiles, -car traffic and -pollution; requires road connection, upkeep scales with fleet.

farm.name: Farm
farm.idea: Agriculture: produces food (+industrial demand for food processing) and must sit away from pollution; lowers land value of adjacent residential slightly but grows with nearby population.
